messages.author: 4f3a300f6b3a3a4d
messages.subject: Re: Disable/Enable actionbutton
parts:
I wrote you a new InputBinding:

In a js file add:

 var actionButtonDisabilitableInputBinding = new Shiny.InputBinding();
  $.extend(actionButtonDisabilitableInputBinding, {
    find: function(scope) {
      return $(scope).find(".action-button-disabilitable");
    },
getValue: function(el) {
      return $(el).data('val') || 0;
    },
    setValue: function(el, value) {
    },
    subscribe: function(el, callback) {
      $(el).on("click.actionButtonDisabilitableInputBinding", function(e) {
        var $el = $(this);
        var val = $el.data('val') || 0;
        $el.data('val', val + 1);

        callback();
      });
    },
    getState: function(el) {
      return { value: this.getValue(el) };
    },
    receiveMessage: function(el, data) {
if (data.hasOwnProperty("disabled")) {
console.log(data.disabled);
if (data.disabled) {
$(el).attr("disabled", "disabled");
}
else {
$(el).removeAttr("disabled");
}
}
    },
unsubscribe: function(el) {
      $(el).off(".actionButtonDisabilitableInputBinding");
    }
  });
  Shiny.inputBindings.register(actionButtonDisabilitableInputBinding, 'shiny.actionButtonDisabilitableInput');

In server.r add:

updateActionButtonDisabilitable <- function(session, inputId, disabled=FALSE) {
  message <- list(disabled=disabled)
  session$sendInputMessage(inputId, message)
}

To disable a button for class 'action-button-disabilitable' (you can change the name XD) width id 'disbutton' simply call:

updateActionButtonDisabilitable(session, "disbutton", TRUE)

and for enabled it:

updateActionButtonDisabilitable(session, "disbutton")

I hope it be useful.
